title: WAMTA social events page data (events.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /events page rendered by _includes/events.md. Lists scheduled receptions, dinners, and excursions with imagery. An entirely-commented template (parses as null) is also accepted.

nav_hidden.description: When true, the page stays reachable but is omitted from the top navigation.

items.description: Ordered list of social events with descriptive title, image, and alt text.

title.description: Event title / one-line description (where, when, what).

image_path.description: Site-relative path to the event image, expected under /assets/years/<year>/events/.
